philosophy: Human-Artisanal Craft UI - Non-Generative, Physics-Driven, High-Contrast Typography, Headless Accessibility

instant_disqualifications: WCAG AA contrast failure (< 4.5:1 text, < 3.0:1 large/controls)
Instant 0ms or transition: all 0.3s ease linear snap

editorial.desc: Hero image reveals, large text slides

typography_rules.display_tracking: -0.04em to -0.055em (tight negative letter-spacing for large titles)
typography_rules.label_metadata: uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.12em, font-family: monospace, font-size: 11px to 13px

font_pairings.heading: Syne / Clash Display / Inter Tight / Outfit

surface_recipes.obsidian_glass: background: rgba(19, 18, 16, 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
surface_recipes.warm_light_glass: background: rgba(250, 248, 245, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);

headless_and_tokens.primitives: Radix UI / React Aria (unstyled, full keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes)
headless_and_tokens.styling: Tailwind with semantic CSS variables (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, bg-primary)
headless_and_tokens.forms: FieldGroup + Field + ToggleGroup (no raw div layout for forms)
headless_and_tokens.iconography: Iconsax 24x24 single-style (Linear or Two-tone) with aria-hidden for decorative and sr-only for actionable
